article.headline: Williams' 20 lead UAPB over Prairie View A&M 84-82
article.description: — Quion Williams scored 20 points as UAPB beat Prairie View A&M 84-82 on Saturday.
article.linkText: Williams' 20 lead UAPB over Prairie View A&M 84-82

categories.description: Prairie View A&M Panthers @ Arkansas-Pine Bluff Golden Lions

event.description: Prairie View A&M Panthers @ Arkansas-Pine Bluff Golden Lions

keywords: Prairie View A&M Panthers @ Arkansas-Pine Bluff Golden Lions
article.story: PINE BLUFF, Ark. -- — Quion Williams scored 20 points as UAPB beat Prairie View A&M 84-82 on Saturday. Williams added five assists and four steals for the Golden Lions (12-16, 9-6 Southwestern Athletic Conference). Jaquan Scott added 18 points while shooting 6 of 6 from the field and 5 for 6 from the line while they also had seven rebounds. Milhan Charles had 17 points and shot 7 of 8 from the field and 2 of 3 from the free-throw line. Dontae Horne finished with 32 points and three steals for the Panthers (11-17, 6-9). Lance Williams added 18 points for Prairie View A&M. Joey Madimba also had 16 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
